bean_snapshot.name: Mexico Mocabe HG
bean_snapshot.notes: HG grade as named by user.

intent: medium-light roast - first roast of a new bean, establish a baseline for Mexico Mocabe HG (washed, Chiapas, 1350 masl)
variable_changed: Baseline for this bean. Carrying over from the La Laja roasts: lid closed, cooled-roaster start, drop on a timer 90s after FC end (compromise between the 60s drop proposed and the 150s/120s used earlier).
hypothesis: On a cooled CB-101 with the lid closed, a 215C charge, 225C at full yellow or 7:00, 235C at cinnamon or 10:00 (no reduction at FC onset) and a timer-driven drop 90s after FC end will give a medium-light roast with 12-13% weight loss, 12-16 min total and DTR ~0.09, sweet and without the smoke seen in roast-20261009-002.

adjustments.reason: full yellow at 6:30 (12:30 left), stepped on yellow
9:00 left clock trigger (10:00 elapsed); very light cinnamon, warm toasty aroma

sensory.aroma_drying: very fresh wheat or dough smell at 3:00 elapsed (16:00 left)
sensory.aroma_maillard: nice nutty aromas at 7:30 (11:30 left); warm, toasty baked nuts at 8:30 (10:30 left)
sensory.color_at_yellowing: not quite peanut color at 5:00 (14 left); peanut color at 5:30 (13:30 left); full yellow at 6:30 (12:30 left); very light cinnamon at 8:30 (10:30 left); full cinnamon reached (user not certain, time not given)
